The parent folder of this document's folder should contain a folder called `Data` with the file `autism_ipp_imputed.rds`. The script `autism_ipp_imputation.qmd` will produce this file if it is not yet present. The parent folder should also contain a folder called `Output`.
:::

## Set up

Quarto runs code from the folder this `.qmd` file is saved in, so you don't need `setwd()`. Relative paths like `../Data/` work as long as the folder layout above is in place.
:::
